name: Relationships In Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that earthly marital relationships do not continue in the resurrection, as believers will be like the angels in heaven, neither marrying nor being given in marriage (Matthew 22:30). Heaven is portrayed as a place of joyful celebration over repentance and restored fellowship with God (Luke 15:7), emphasizing spiritual relationships rather than earthly ties. While marriage on earth is governed by God's commands regarding faithfulness (Luke 16:18), the peace and unity among believers in heaven reflect a transformed relational reality centered on Christ's presence (John 20:19).
